subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should maintainers require live Matrix verification proof before accepting this private matrix-js-sdk Rust crypto preprocessor hook?
rationale: The patch is a focused bug fix, but it depends on a private dependency field and changes Matrix E2EE verification preprocessing, so automation should not treat green tests as enough to own that risk.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof first
options.body: Ask for redacted Element/Synapse verification logs, terminal output, linked artifact, or recording from this branch before merge.

options.title: Accept the hook with override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the private SDK hook and proof gap if the linked issue evidence is enough for this release.

options.title: Pause for upstream direction
options.body: If the private hook is not acceptable, pause this PR and pursue an upstream matrix-js-sdk or Element compatibility path instead.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Element/Synapse verification logs, terminal output, linked artifact, or recording from this branch before merge.
